  {"step":7,"file":"include/fmt/core.h","function":"basic_format_args<Context>::get_id","line":1933,"var":"named_args.data[i].name","code":"for (size_t i = 0; i < named_args.size; ++i) { if (named_args.data[i].name == name) return named_args.data[i].id; }","note":"The vulnerable sink is a linear scan that dereferences each stored name pointer while comparing it to the attacker-controlled lookup key; the fuzz target reports a stack-buffer-overflow read here when the name handling goes out of bounds."}
